title: Reading Drill — Studying compost bins in courtyards — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Studying compost bins in courtyards — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The housing project lead in Cairnford received an old report about residents avoiding bins with awkward lids. The report compared use per week, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the collection logs rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered three weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include holiday occupancy. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed lighter lids with handles as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
